about.label: The role
about.title: AI Creative Talent
about.subtitle: Art Direction, Design & Animation
about.p1: We're looking for Art Directors, Designers, Animators and creative professionals with experience and command of AI tools, who are exploring new ways of creating.
about.p2: People with repertoire, a creative eye, experience and technical craft — able to turn ideas into images, concepts, animation and visual narrative, and to take an idea further than what we already know.
about.p3: We believe the tools are part of the process. What interests us is what you create with them.
about.p4: We want to see your work, understand how AI fits into your creative process, and discover new possibilities together with you.
about.p5: If this sounds like you, fill in the form below, share your portfolio or demo reel, and select the AI tools you work with.
about.closing: Let's find out what comes next.
